en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground there is a railway line with a steam locomotive and carriages beside station buildings and tracks. Behind the tracks, clustered houses, a church with a tower, and other town buildings spread up the slope of a wooded hill. The scene is rural and early‑industrial in character. In the top right corner, printed text reads the town name and region.
